title: DiskUsage
description: Collection of disk usage entries parsed from df -h output

DiskUsageEntry.description: A single disk usage entry from df -h output

filesystem.description: The mounted device or source (e.g. /dev/disk3s5, devfs, map auto_home) as reported in df's first column.

size.description: Total size of the filesystem, human-readable with df -h's unit suffix (e.g. 926Gi, 500G).

used.description: Space currently used on the filesystem, human-readable with df -h's unit suffix.

available.description: Space still available on the filesystem, human-readable with df -h's unit suffix.

use_percent.description: Used space as a percentage of total capacity, including the trailing '%' (e.g. 70%).
